title: How to Stay Ahead of Cutting Edge Game Technology
prompt: Build a 20-year game technology evolution quiz show. Technology trend cards appear one at a time (ray tracing, procedural gen, neural rendering, haptics) and the player must drag each to its correct decade on a horizontal timeline. Correct placements unlock a brief tooltip about that tech's game-dev impact. A final 'emerging tech' round asks the player to predict which 2026+ technologies will matter. Retro quiz-show TV-set aesthetic with spinning wheel graphic.
